body:
It lasts for a month and takes place every year from mid-June to the middle of July. It showcases the variety and richness of
performing arts traditions from the different regions in Bali, as well as other
provinces in Indonesia and a number of foreign countries.
sections.heading: The festival is held in Denpasar at the Werdhi Budaya Art Centre.

body: The festival is traditionally opened by the President of Indonesia.
sections.heading: On the opening day, an enormous parade of all the performing groups is held in Renon, Denpasar.
